facts.fact: CIO Mag reports, from an interview with the ministry's director of innovation, that the national AI strategy was officially handed over (remise) on 13 March 2025, with a planned budget of over 1,000 billion FCFA for 2025-2030 and a National AI Agency to be created first; no adoption is stated.

systems.owner: Ministère de la Transition Numérique et de la Digitalisation
